text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that Community Council not authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Wishing Well Drive and Farmcrest Drive as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This T-type intersection currently has a stop control for the eastbound movement on Farmcrest Drive facing Wishing Well Drive.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Wishing Well Drive and Farmcrest Drive.
